<div class="card-body">
'''Momaw Nadon''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Momaw Nadon]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 99 (index 4055). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">モモー・ネイドン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">支配フェイズに、同じ位置にいる動物（バンサ、デューバック、ワンパ、ランコア、ブーボ、ドラゴンスネーク）を罠にかける（盗む）ことができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-momaw-nadon-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">樹木を愛し、ハンマー・ヘッド（カナヅチ頭）と蔑称されるアイソリアンの男性。動植物の繁殖、栽培の名手。栽培船の元指揮官。反乱軍のスパイ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Momaw Nadon.

'''Card text:''' During the control phase, he may trap, or steal, an animal at the same site: a bantha, dewback, wampa, rancor, Bubo, or dragonsnake.

'''Lore:''' A tree-loving male Ithorian derogatorily called Hammerhead. An expert in breeding animals and cultivating plants. Former commander of a cultivation ship. A Rebel spy.
